quantize_numpy_array: quantize a numpy array to a GGML quantization type like Q4_0, Q8_0, or Q5_K
dequantize_quantized_data: dequantize quantized numpy data back to float32 for a given GGML quantization type
convert_quant_shape_to_byte_shape: convert a quantized tensor shape to its byte storage shape for a given quantization type
convert_byte_shape_to_quant_shape: convert a byte storage shape back to the original quantized tensor shape
dequantize_blocks_Q4_K: dequantize Q4_K blocks from GGUF format back to float32 values
